χάσμημα.definition: a wide yawn or gape, Ar.Av.61

χαυνοπολίτης.definition: gaping fool, who swallows open-mouthed all that is told him , Ar.Ach.635

χεζητιάω.definition: Desiderat. of want to ease oneself, Ar.Nu.1387, Ra.8, al

χειραπτάζω.definition: touch with the hand, take in hand, handle, Hdt.2.90

χειραψία.definition: violence offered, rough; hand to hand fight, close combat, Anon. ap. Suid

χειρεργάτης.definition: one who works by hand, Tz.H.10.779

χρυσοβέλεμνος.definition: with shafts, arrows of gold, AP9.623 , Orac. ap. Lyd.Mens.3.10

χρυσοβήρυλλος.definition: beryl with a tinge of gold colour, Plin.HN37.76

χρυσόβωλος.definition: with soil of gold, i.e. containing gold, E.Rh.921
